audience: clinic staff who look up patient charts in Canvas Medical

useCases.title: Get a chart summary for one patient
useCases.text: The AI finds the patient and reads the full record in one bundle. It sums up the conditions, medications, allergies and recent visits for a quick review.

useCases.title: Review the active medications of a patient
useCases.text: The AI searches the medication requests of one patient and lists the active ones with dose and start date.

useCases.title: Check the problem list and allergies
useCases.text: The AI searches the conditions and allergy records of one patient. You see the problem list and the recorded allergies side by side.

useCases.title: Find out what the Canvas instance supports
useCases.text: The AI reads the capability statement of your instance. It tells you which resources and search parameters you can use.
